title: 第20章 想干吗第二十一章 我能进去吗
slug: 魔头别夺舍了我们正道快没人了
lines: 此后数日，季南北又去了苏千雪那儿两趟。
苏千雪这几日修炼亦有突破，已至练气二层境界。
而季南北前往的原因也很简单
趁着手中尚有余存符篆，多猎杀几头筑基妖兽，用以淬炼体魄。
妖丹淬体的效果确实惊人，季南北的肉身强度正以不可思议的速度提升着。
这一日，那位常年神龙见首不见尾的师姐林梦夕也难得露了面。
当林梦夕发觉季南北已达练气巅峰时，着实吃了一惊。
“好家伙，你还真赶上进度了?难不成一个月内你真能突破筑基?”季南北简直想骂人。
合着这位不靠谱的师姐当初定下“一月筑基”的目标时，根本就没指望他能完成是吧。
那她先前嚷嚷个什么劲!
“有什么诀窍没?快跟师姐说说。”
林梦夕笑眯眯地凑近。
“心诚则灵。”
噎了师姐一句后，季南北想起一事，正色问道:
“师姐，请教一下，人族修士能否直接吞服妖兽内丹?听闻那是妖兽修为的核心。”
林梦夕闻言，也收敛了笑容，摇头道:
“怎么可能。妖兽内丹向来只能用于炼器或炼丹，即便入药，也仅萃取其中部分精华淬炼药材。人族若直接吞服，轻则丹田受损，重则爆体而亡。”
说罢，她又狐疑地瞥了季南北一眼。
“你该不会想走偏门，去吞那玩意儿吧?我劝你趁早打消这念头，师姐我可不想眼睁睁看着小师弟在面前炸成烟花。”
季南北摇头。
“自然不会，多谢师姐告知。”
得到这一信息后，季南北已能确定，人族修士确实无法像苏千雪那般直接吞服妖丹淬体。
而凭借夺舍系统能同步进行妖丹淬体的季南北，恐怕日后将成为人族修士中的异数。
眼下季南北仅是肉身强度略超常轨，尚未引发质变。
但若持续淬炼下去，终有一日他将成就肉身硬撼灵宝的恐怖存在。
传说中的“肉身成圣”，季南北说不定也能修出个类似境界。
届时，肉身强横无匹、灵气术法又凌厉惊人的季南北，还有谁能匹敌?
之后，季南北又与林梦夕聊了几句，便各自分开。
季南北并未将程灵儿师尊的状况告知林梦夕。
或许师姐知晓，或许不知，但这是师尊的私事，理应由师尊自行决定是否透露，季南北不愿多此一举。
当然，对于程灵儿的状况，季南北心中已有几分盘算。
content_en:
In the next few days, Ji Nanbei went to Su Qianxue's place twice more.
Su Qianxue has also made breakthroughs in her cultivation in the past few days and has reached the second level of Qi training.
The reason for Ji Nanbei's trip is also very simple.
While there are still some remaining talismans in hand, hunt down a few more foundation-building monsters to temper your body.
The demonic elixir's body-tempering effect was indeed astonishing, and Ji Nanbei's physical strength was increasing at an incredible speed.
On this day, Lin Mengxi, the senior sister who had always seen the dragon but never saw its end, also made a rare appearance.
Lin Mengxi was really surprised when she discovered that Ji Nanbei had reached the peak of Qi training.
"Good guy, have you really caught up with the progress? Is it possible that you can really break through the foundation building within a month?" Ji Nanbei just wanted to curse.
Co-author: When this unreliable senior sister originally set the goal of "building a foundation in one month", she didn't expect him to be able to complete it, right?
Then what was she yelling about earlier?
"Do you have any tips? Tell senior sister quickly."
Lin Mengxi came closer with a smile.
"Sincerity leads to spiritual success."
"?"
After choking his senior sister, Ji Nanbei remembered something and asked seriously:
"Sister, please tell me, can human monks directly swallow the inner elixir of monsters? I heard that it is the core of the cultivation of monsters."
Hearing this, Lin Mengxi also suppressed her smile, shook her head and said:
"How is that possible? The inner elixir of monsters can only be used to refine weapons or elixirs. Even if it is used as medicine, only part of the essence is extracted to temper the medicinal materials. If a human being swallows it directly, the Dantian will be damaged in the least, and the body will explode and die in the worst case."
After saying that, she glanced at Ji Nanbei suspiciously.
"You don't want to go out of your way to swallow that thing, do you? I advise you to give up this idea as soon as possible. Senior sister, I don't want to watch my junior brother explode into fireworks in front of me."
Ji Nanbei shook his head.
"Of course not. Thank you, senior sister, for informing me."
After receiving this information, Ji Nanbei was able to confirm that human monks were indeed unable to directly swallow the Demonic Core Tempered Body like Su Qianxue.
And Ji Nanbei, who can simultaneously temper the demon elixir with the help of the Body Seizing System, may become an anomaly among human monks in the future.
At the moment, Ji Nanbei's physical strength is only slightly above normal, but has not yet caused a qualitative change.
But if he continues to temper, one day he will achieve a terrifying existence that can physically defeat the spiritual treasure.
Ji Nanbei might also be able to achieve a similar state to the legendary "body sanctification".
By then, who else can compete with Ji Nanbei, who is unrivaled in physical strength and whose aura skills are astonishing?
After that, Ji Nanbei chatted with Lin Mengxi for a few more words and then separated.
Ji Nanbei did not inform Lin Mengxi of Master Cheng Ling'er's condition.
Maybe senior sister knows, maybe she doesn't, but this is Master's private matter, and it should be up to Master to decide whether to disclose it or not. Ji Nanbei doesn't want to bother with it.
Of course, Ji Nanbei had already made some calculations about Cheng Ling'er's situation.
